title: Later Proposal Reason
description: Why the seller created a proposal after the creating task completed. Lets a buyer agent or planner triage a later proposal without reading seller prose. Experimental (media_buy.open_opportunities).

enumDescriptions.delayed_response: The seller's answer to the stored brief took longer than the creating task. Typical of sales desks with human review.
enumDescriptions.revised_terms: The seller revised one of its own earlier proposals for this opportunity. The new snapshot SHOULD carry parent_proposal_id naming the proposal it revises.
enumDescriptions.new_inventory: Inventory relevant to the stored brief became available after the creating task.
enumDescriptions.event_package: A package tied to a dated event inside the planning horizon, such as a sports final or a holiday.
enumDescriptions.other: None of the above. The snapshot's brief_alignment SHOULD explain the reason.
